title: Smoked Chicken Tagine
description: A traditional North African-inspired dish with smoky chicken, served in a Thai-style coconut milk sauce.

ingredients.name: Coconut milk
ingredients.notes: Full-fat or low-fat, whichever you prefer

ingredients.name: Fish sauce
ingredients.notes: Can substitute with soy sauce or tamari

ingredients.name: Ginger
ingredients.notes: Grated or sliced, whichever you prefer

ingredients.name: Garlic
ingredients.notes: Minced or crushed, whichever you prefer

instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven or heavy pot over medium-high heat.
Add chicken and cook until browned, about 5 minutes. Remove from pot and set aside.
Reduce heat to medium and add smoked paprika. Cook, stirring constantly, for 1 minute.
Add coconut milk, fish sauce, brown sugar, ginger, garlic, salt, and black pepper. Stir to combine.
Return chicken to pot and bring to a simmer.
Reduce heat to low and cook, covered, until chicken is cooked through and sauce has thickened, about 20-25 minutes.
Stir in fresh cilantro and serve hot.
Garnish with additional cilantro, if desired.
Serve over rice or noodles, if desired.
